prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, model reference sheet for a 3D artist. Image 1 is a paintover of four Japanese kei vehicles parked in the Mega Park car park in the game Yorimichi. Image 2 is another place in the same game and shows the art direction: soft painterly low-poly shapes, flat matte shading, simple chunky forms, indigo tiled roofs, autumn maples and ginkgos in rust, orange and gold, dark green pines, a clean blue sky. Paint a clean reference sheet of the same four vehicles on a plain warm light-grey background, evenly lit, each with only a soft contact shadow: four rows, one vehicle per row, each shown in a front three-quarter view on the left and an exact side view on the right, all at the same scale. Keep their designs, colours and proportions exactly as in image 1: the sage-green kei pickup with the cab-over front, cream roof, drop-side bed, crates and skateboard; the tall boxy cream and ochre kei wagon; the small round vermilion retro kei car with a cream roof and round headlights; the indigo one-box microvan with a white stripe and a roof rack with skateboards. Show them as the game models them: few polygons, chunky softly bevelled boxes, flat matte colour, dark simple windows, small black tyres with pale hubs, plain yellow number plates without characters. No logos, no labels, no text.
